data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Euangelion', meaning 'good news' or 'gospel'. Ewall is a name of power and divine origin, representing the message and love of God. The name Ewall carries the meaning “Power from God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ewall usually hope their child will grow to embody power from god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
